== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Was known in Korean solo queue as an {{ci|Evelynn}} one-trick before playing competitively.
* He reached Rank 1 on season 11 on the NA server.

=== Individual Awards ===
* LLA player with the most MVPs in the split (Closing 2022)
* LLA Most Weekly MVPs in his role in the split (Closing 2022)
* LLA All Pro Team (Opening 2021)
* LLA Most Valuable Player (Opening 2021)
* LLA Best Import Player (Opening 2021)
